headline: 750,000 barrels per day via 'Jihan' and oil reveals expansion plans
summary: Iraq's Ministry of Oil said the agreement with Turkey aims to export up to 750,000 barrels of crude per day, with possible increases. Work on the Basra–Haditha–Kirkuk–Jihan pipeline is continuing.
why: Pipeline export routes through Turkey give Iraq an alternative to Gulf shipping lanes, which matters for crude supply and Iraqi revenues.
